description: Implementation of HalProxy class managing sensor HAL interactions, dynamic sensor management, threading, and communication with sensor sub-HALs in Android.

classes.name: HalProxy
classes.description: Manages sensor HAL interactions, dynamic sensors, threading, and communication with sub-HALs.

methods.name: setSubHalIndex
methods.description: Sets the sub-hal index as the first byte of the sensor handle.

methods.name: extractSubHalIndex
methods.description: Extracts the sub-hal index from a sensor handle.

methods.name: msFromNs
methods.description: Converts nanoseconds to milliseconds.

methods.name: initializeSubHalListFromConfigFile
methods.description: Loads sub-HAL libraries from configuration file and initializes them.

methods.name: initializeSensorList
methods.description: Loads sensor list from each sub-HAL and stores sensor info.

methods.name: getHandleForSubHalSharedObject
methods.description: Loads shared object handle for a sub-HAL library.

methods.name: stopThreads
methods.description: Stops all running threads and joins them.

methods.name: disableAllSensors
methods.description: Disables all sensors across sub-HALs.

methods.name: handlePendingWrites
methods.description: Thread function handling pending sensor event writes.

methods.name: handleWakelocks
methods.description: Thread function managing wakelock acquisition and release.

methods.name: sharedWakelockDidTimeout
methods.description: Checks if wakelock has timed out.

methods.name: resetSharedWakelock
methods.description: Resets wakelock state and ref count.

methods.name: postEventsToMessageQueue
methods.description: Posts sensor events to message queue, managing pending events and wakelocks.

methods.name: incrementRefCountAndMaybeAcquireWakelock
methods.description: Increments wakelock ref count and acquires wakelock if needed.

methods.name: decrementRefCountAndMaybeReleaseWakelock
methods.description: Decrements wakelock ref count and releases wakelock if count reaches zero.

methods.name: setDirectChannelFlags
methods.description: Sets flags for direct channel support on sensors.

methods.name: getSubHalForSensorHandle
methods.description: Retrieves sub-HAL wrapper for a given sensor handle.

methods.name: isSubHalIndexValid
methods.description: Checks if sensor handle's sub-HAL index is valid.

methods.name: countNumWakeupEvents
methods.description: Counts wake-up events in a list of sensor events.

methods.name: clearSubHalIndex
methods.description: Clears the sub-HAL index bits from a sensor handle.

methods.name: subHalIndexIsClear
methods.description: Checks if the sub-HAL index bits are clear in a sensor handle.
